scope_note: someone here did something / because of this it is here

label: migrated
scope_note: someone here did something before / it was in another place at that time / it is here now

label: STATUS
scope_note: Facet: what people here are doing with this. Values are f:st-*

scope_note: people thought of it for a long time / now they do not want it to be other

label: draft
scope_note: someone did something / because of this it is / it can be other

label: on-hold
scope_note: people are not doing something with it now / maybe after some time they will do something with it

scope_note: people did it before / now they know it is not good / it is here because it is good if people know this

label: archived
scope_note: it was true before / now it is not true / it is here because people want to know it as it was before

label: PRESERVATION
scope_note: Facet: what happens to this if the people who hold it stop being there. Values are f:pres-*

scope_note: if all the people who know it die / someone can know it one more time because of this

label: reconstructible

label: n/a
scope_note: if all the people who know it die / something bad does not happen
